# SEO and metadata audit — 2026-09-03

Automated audit run. No changed-file list or date range accompanied this run, so the scope was the first 40 indexed pages in alphabetical order by path (`agent/customize` through `api/analytics/searches`).

## Result

All 40 pages in scope pass every hard check (title present and ≤60 characters, non-boilerplate; description present, unique, and within length bounds). No metadata was changed.

The 9 API reference pages in scope (`api/agent/v2/*`, `api/analytics/*`) have no `description:` frontmatter by design: each uses an OpenAPI operation reference, and the referenced operations in `admin-openapi.json` and `analytics.openapi.json` all define a `description`. Verified, not defects.

## Limitations

The clone for this run was shallow (depth 1) and could not be deepened. The missing-redirect scan (deletes/renames in the last 30 days) and the prior-automation churn check were skipped because both depend on git history.

## Findings not fixed

### Duplicate description (out of scope)

`assistant/widget-preview.mdx`, `es/assistant/widget-preview.mdx`, `fr/assistant/widget-preview.mdx`, and `zh/assistant/widget-preview.mdx` share the description "Host page for the live preview in the assistant widget playground." All four are `noindex: true` utility pages and none is in scope for this run. The localized copies also carry English metadata.

### Orphans (built and served, absent from navigation, no noindex)

English pages, each mirrored at the same path in `es/`, `fr/`, and `zh/`:

| Page | Notes | Suggested handling |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `contact-support` | Linked from the navbar as an external URL | Intentional unlisted page; add `noindex` or a nav entry |
| `advanced-support` | Linked from content | Add to navigation or `noindex` |
| `enterprise-contracting` | No inbound links found | Add to navigation, `noindex`, or delete |
| `migration-services/enterprise` | Linked from content | Add to navigation or `noindex` |
| `status` | No inbound links found | Add to navigation or `noindex` |
| `guides/auth0` | No inbound links found | Add to navigation, redirect, or `noindex` |
| `ai/slack-bot` | Linked from content | Add to navigation or `noindex` |
| `api-playground/websocket-playground` | Linked from content | Add to navigation or `noindex` |
| `organize/hidden-page-example` | Deliberate demo linked from `organize/hidden-pages` | Leave; optionally add `noindex` |
| `api/agent/create-agent-job`, `api/agent/get-agent-job`, `api/agent/get-all-jobs` | Deprecated v1 endpoints (`tag: deprecated`); v2 pages are in navigation | Redirect to v2 counterparts or add `noindex` |
| `api/assistant/create-assistant-message` | Deprecated v1 endpoint; v2 page is in navigation | Redirect to v2 counterpart or add `noindex` |

No existing redirect in `docs.json` covers any of these paths.

`poc-onboarding`, `migration-services/go-live-checklist`, and `assistant/widget-preview` (plus their locale mirrors) are also absent from navigation but already set `noindex: true`; nothing needed.

### Indexable pages that should not be

The four deprecated v1 API pages above are tagged deprecated but carry no `noindex`.
